== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[You Will Take Me To Jabba Now (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p4-81-You_Will_Take_Me_To_Jabba_Now.png]]), the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-youwilltakemetojabbanow-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip (2013) show the original words (see [[You Will Take Me To Jabba Now (V)]]).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured 12 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html). The list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. May ▼ Seeking An Audience or an alien to Audience Chamber (for -1 Force). OR Reveal up to 3 Aliens stacked on I Know That Laugh or from hand (X = number of aliens revealed); activate X Force.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch R8-U run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
